description: This file defines function declarations and data structures related to launching and managing text editors in a Git environment, including functions for launching editors, sequence editors, checking terminal types, and editing buffers interactively.

methods.name: git_editor
methods.description: Returns the preferred editor command as a string.

methods.name: git_sequence_editor
methods.description: Returns the sequence editor command as a string.

methods.name: is_terminal_dumb
methods.description: Checks if the terminal is a dumb terminal.

methods.name: launch_editor
methods.description: Launches the user's preferred editor to edit a file and fills the buffer with the file's contents after editing.

methods.name: launch_sequence_editor
methods.description: Launches the sequence editor, similar to launch_editor.

methods.name: strbuf_edit_interactively
methods.description: Writes out the buffer to a file, opens it in an editor for editing, then reads the edited content back into the buffer and deletes the temporary file.
